description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE                                                                                                                                                                            W912ER26RA025                                                                                                                                                                 Procurement of Shiplift Spare PartsThe U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Southwestern Division, Middle East District (SWM), is issuing this sources sought announcement to conduct market research, seeking to identify qualified parties with the capability to procure various spare parts identified within Appendix A and in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS).As a result of this market research, the U.S. Government will gain a better understanding of industry capabilities for this potential future requirement.This is a sources sought announcement for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. No contract will be awarded from this announcement. The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with the submission of information in response to this notice. All information submitted is voluntary. Do not submit classified material.Interested and qualified parties are invited to submit a complete Statement of Capabilities (template attached).Submission Deadline: No later than 10:00 AM EDT on April 17, 2026.Submission Instructions:? Email to: Contract Specialist Diane deLathouder at Diane.E.deLathouder@usace.army.mil Contracting Officer Peter Smith at Peter.S.Smith@usace.army.mil? Email Subject Line: [Your Company Name], Response to Sources Sought W912ER26RA025
